title: UI critique (Medium): Settings Goals selects use unstyled platform controls
description: Goal scope and Goal day are bare <select> elements (src/App.tsx:1825,1831) and no CSS file styles select (grep of src/**/*.css finds no select rule). In Chromium they render as default grey-bordered selects in the system font, not Futura (screens/browser-settings-light-color.png); in native WebKit they render as rounded Aqua pop-up buttons with small system text (screens/native-settings-light-color.png) - both break the design system's interface typeface and 'flat surfaces, square corners' rule, next to the app's own flat Dropdown and segmented controls. The two number fields keep native steppers in WebKit. Suggested: reuse the existing Dropdown component (src/components/Dropdown.tsx) or give select font: inherit, appearance: none, 1 px var(--line) border, square corners and a chevron, matching .dropdown-trigger. Reference: iA Writer/Ulysses settings use the system's own controls consistently or fully custom ones, never a mix in one pane.

review.note: Approved. Diff: both Goals selects -> Dropdown with identical option lists/values (manuscript, manuscript-and-fragments, local, utc), onChange -> patchGoalPreference, aria-label via label prop, visible span.settings-label, no caption added (the shortened help text is T094's). performance.spec swaps only the driver (pick() option labels map to the same values; toHaveValue -> toContainText of the same choices). Fail-first log shows Arial vs Futura stack on the old build. tsc 0; fresh build in ui-t95-review, features+appearance+accessibility+performance 30/30, 1 worker, 0 retries; keyboard-only Enter/ArrowDown/Enter on both dropdowns persists after reload (scope=Manuscript and fragments, day=UTC). Shots: Futura, square, tokens, open menu not clipped. Non-blocking: Total/Daily goal and Deadline labels remain darker than the muted Goal scope/day labels in the same block (owner noted, pre-existing label style); native WebKit unverified.
